Question 9
?

The curve C is the intersection of a surface S, defined by z=f(x,y), with the plane x=e. Given that the point P(e,2,3) lies on C, and that fy=2ln⁡x−eyx2, find the equations of the tangent line to C at P.

a
{x=ez=2y−1
b
{x=ez=2y−3
c
{x=ez=y+3
d
{x=ez=y+1
e
{x=ez=y−2
